description: The attract-mode demos played when the title screen is left idle. rotation: played in order, wrapping around; setup is the disc file with the demo's settings, save, frame count and start seed, play the recorded pad input (16 bytes per frame). step_states: the game states in which the recording advances one frame. exit: while the game is in in_state, the demo ends when the system state becomes on_sys_state or the previous game state was after_state. exit_timer_vblanks: the demo timer set on exit, in vblanks (60 per second; past soft_reset.json demo_vblanks). seed_advance: added to the saved random seed between the two world passes of a demo frame. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
